title: Affiliate Manager
desc: Company Description Bullwaves is a regulated Forex and CFD broker that combines extensive industry expertise with the innovation and energy of a dynamic, youthful team. We are dedicated to providing traders with secure and trusted services while leveraging cutting-edge technology to stay ahead of market trends. Our goal is to empower traders of all levels with the tools and knowledge they need to succeed in the Forex market. Join our team and contribute to shaping the future of global trading with passion and excellence. Role Description We are looking for a highly connected Affiliate Manager with an existing portfolio of active affiliates and Introducing Brokers (IBs) in the Forex / financial / prop trading space. This role is focused on immediate impact — bringing revenue from day one through established partner relationships. Key Responsibilities Portfolio Activation & Revenue Growth • Leverage an existing portfolio of affiliates and IBs to generate immediate FTDs and trading volume • Reactivate dormant partners and scale top-performing ones • Continuously grow partner revenue through optimization and upselling Affiliate & IB Management • Manage day-to-day communication with affiliates and IBs • Negotiate and optimize CPA, RevShare, and hybrid deals • Provide partners with tailored offers, funnels, and marketing support Partner Acquisition • Expand your existing network by onboarding new affiliates and IBs • Build relationships with trading communities, educators, and influencers Performance Optimization • Track KPIs: FTDs, CPA, ROI, LTV, trading volume • Optimize funnels (landing pages, onboarding, deposit flow) • Monitor and improve conversion rates across GEOs Cross-Functional Collaboration • Work with CRM/Retention teams to improve trader lifetime value • Coordinate with Sales on lead conversion quality • Align with Product/Dealing teams on trading conditions and offers Requirements • 2–5+ years in affiliate marketing within Forex / CFDs / crypto / prop trading • Proven portfolio of active affiliates and IBs (must be able to demonstrate performance) • Ability to bring FTDs within the first 30–60 days • Strong understanding of IB models and commission structures and Trader lifecycle (lead → FTD → retention → volume) • Hands-on, revenue-driven mindset Remuneration & Benefits • Competitive compensation package • 28 days of annual leave • 10 days of paid sick leave • Remote work environment • A dynamic, collaborative environment with room to grow Ready to Join Us? If you believe this role aligns with your skills and ambitions, we encourage you to submit your resume. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality. Please note that we may keep your CV for a period of one (1) year for future relevant job opportunities.

title: Affiliate & Growth Networks Specialist
desc: Blockchain is connecting the world to the future of finance. As the most trusted and fastest-growing global crypto company, it helps millions of people worldwide safely access cryptocurrency. Since its inception in 2011, Blockchain has earned the trust of over 90 million wallet holders and more than 40 million verified users, facilitating over $1 trillion in crypto transactions. We are hiring a Affiliate & Growth Networks Specialist to own the end-to-end partner ecosystem at Blockchain.com. Your primary mandate will be to drive high-volume, high-value users into our ecosystem, with a massive focus on identifying and onboarding clients eligible for our premium wealth.blockchain.com suite. This is definitely not a corporate affiliate management role. We don't want someone who just manages generic link-sharing portals. We need a super-connected, crypto-native operator who can seamlessly walk the line between elite alpha groups and institutional wealth. You must be someone who can unapologetically grind through direct outreach, slide into the right DMs, deploy your own pre-existing black book of partners, and construct highly incentivized affiliate deals that move millions in trading volume and deposits. WHAT YOU WILL DO The Whale & VIP Affiliate Pipeline You will own the acquisition strategy for high-net-worth and high-volume users. You will target, pitch, and lock in alpha groups, VIP traders, private yield communities, and prominent Web3 key opinion leaders (KOLs) who can funnel qualified, high-liquidity traffic straight to wealth.blockchain.com . Broad-Scale Retail & Perp Network Growth Beyond the high-net-worth tier, you will scale our broader affiliate network to drive massive volume into our core retail products, including prediction markets, perpetual futures, and upcoming token launches. You will build and optimize tiered incentive models that turn everyday creators into hyper-active distribution nodes. Direct Outreach & Relentless Grinding You will hunt down partners across Twitter/X, Telegram, Discord, and Farcaster. You know that the best affiliates aren’t looking at traditional job boards—they are in private chats, trading rooms, and on-chain governance forums. You will spend your days executing high-conviction outreach to build relationships from scratch. Affiliate Campaign Architecture & Tooling You will design, launch, and monitor custom-tailored commission structures, rebates, and volume-based incentive programs. You will ensure our tracking mechanisms, dashboard attribution, and payout pipelines run flawlessly so partners get paid accurately and stay motivated to ship traffic. Competitor Intelligence & Narrative Arbitrage You will actively monitor what rival exchanges, DeFi protocols, and wealth management platforms are offering their affiliates. You will use this intelligence to structure superior, unrejectable deals that systematically poach top-tier distribution networks over to Blockchain.com. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Build, scale, and optimize Blockchain.com’s global Web3 affiliate and partner network. Execute aggressive daily outreach campaigns to recruit high-signal affiliates, trading communities, and Web3 micro-influencers. Leverage and activate your personal network of whales, heavy traders, and community founders on day one. Design custom incentive structures specifically optimized to drive users to wealth.blockchain.com, perpetuals, and token launch pools. Manage the relationship lifecycle for our highest-earning affiliates, providing them with bespoke assets, early product access, and direct feedback loops. Partner cross-functionally with product, content and Legal/Compliance to execute promotions. Track, analyze, and report on performance —knowing exactly which partners drive the highest customer lifetime value (LTV) versus toxic or low-value flow. WHAT YOU WILL NEED Required Experience 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in affiliate marketing, business development, or growth partnerships strictly within the Web3, DeFi, or crypto exchange sectors. Deep, authentic crypto literacy —you are an active on-chain participant. You understand liquidity sourcing, derivatives trading, perps, tokenomics, and what actually makes a trader migrate platforms. A proven, referenceable network of active Web3 affiliates, alpha groups, Telegram signal rooms, or copy-trading communities. A relentless outreach mindset —you view business development as a numbers game paired with flawless high-context tailoring. You are not afraid of cold pitching or navigating closed networks. Strong understanding of referral tooling and data attribution mechanics. You know how tracking links, cookies, and on-chain referral contracts work structurally. Excellent negotiation skills ; you know how to build win-win commission structures that motivate affiliates while maintaining healthy customer acquisition costs (CAC). Preferred Experience Direct experience working with crypto KOLs , OTC desks, or premium private banking-style crypto products. Deep active immersion inside specific geographical crypto hubs (e.g., APAC, LATAM, or Europe's trading ecosystems). Familiarity with compliance boundaries regarding financial product promotions and affiliate marketing across multiple jurisdictions. COMPENSATION & PERKS Full-time salary based on experience and meaningful equity in an industry-leading company Role based in our London office, with a mandatory in-office presence four days per week Work from Anywhere Policy: You can work remotely from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days per year. ClassPass Budgets for learning & professional development Unlimited vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it Apple equipment The opportunity to be a key player and build your career at a rapidly expanding, global technology company in an emerging field Flexible work culture Blockchain is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, and apprenticeship. Blockchain makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. The personal data you provide will be used by Blockchain to process your application. To learn more about your rights, see our Applicant Privacy notice .

desc: About TBM Funded TBM Funded is a Dubai-based proprietary trading firm running simulated evaluation challenges for skilled traders. title: Introducing Broker (IB)
desc: Company Description Trade W is a leading multi-asset trading platform in the financial services industry, with over eight years of experience and a team of 200–500 employees. The company serves more than 6 million active users worldwide through its app and website, offering CFD trading across forex, cryptocurrency, stocks, indices, metals, and commodities. Trade W’s mission is to provide global traders with accessible tools, knowledge, and opportunities that help them create value and achieve success. By combining advanced technology with a transparent, efficient trading environment, the platform aims to build an open, inclusive, and future-focused global trading ecosystem. With traders at the core, Trade W focuses on innovation, trust, and sustainable market growth. Role Description This is a full-time remote role for an Introducing Broker (IB) at Trade W. The IB will focus on identifying, onboarding, and maintaining relationships with clients and partners interested in multi-asset CFD trading, including forex, cryptocurrency, stocks, indices, metals, and commodities. Daily responsibilities include prospecting and generating leads, presenting Trade W’s platform features, guiding new clients through account opening and onboarding, and supporting them in understanding platform tools and services. The IB will monitor client activity, provide ongoing support and education, coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues, and ensure a positive trading experience. The role also involves developing localized outreach strategies, tracking performance metrics, and adhering to compliance and regulatory guidelines in relevant markets. Key Responsibilities Contact and manage customers assigned by the company. Identify customers with the potential to become IB Partners. Introduce the IB Partner Program and convert suitable candidates. Guide new partners through onboarding, training and activation. Monitor partner activity, client conversion and business performance. Maintain accurate follow-up records in the CRM system. Reactivate inactive or underperforming partners. Ensure all partner activities follow company and compliance requirements. Provide regular performance and local market feedback. Requirements At least two years of experience in B2C sales, client conversion, customer relationship management or another customer-facing role. Experience managing company-assigned leads or customer portfolios. Strong communication, relationship-building and objection-handling skills. Proven ability to convert and develop individual customers. Able to manage multiple customers through structured follow-up. Comfortable working with CRM systems and measurable monthly KPIs. Fluent English and local languages. Minimum Bachelor's degree as highest qualification. Preferred Experience in retail trading, fintech, online trading or financial services. Experience in IB, affiliate or partner development. Experience in customer onboarding, training, retention or activation. Additional regional language skills. Existing local trading or partner resources. Key Success Measures Conversion of assigned customers into IB Partners. Number of newly activated IB Partners. Valid clients generated by managed partners. Partner activity and retention. Net deposits and trading contribution from the managed network.

title: Head of IB - Thailand
desc: LBX Overview LBX is a cutting-edge online broker that offers a secure and transparent trading experience and is regulated by the Financial Services Commission of Mauritius. Inspired by its “Trade ON” philosophy, LBX empowers traders to stay resilient, move decisively, and seize every opportunity. As the Official Online Trading Partner of the Audi Revolut F1® Team, LBX blends the exciting worlds of F1 and online trading with precision, speed and innovation. LBX is operated by MAEX LIMITED, a company registered in the Republic of Mauritius (Registration No. 158250 C1/GBL) and it is part of the Libertex Group, which has been connecting millions of traders with global financial markets since 1997. To find out more about LBX visit lbx.com Job Overview We are looking for a highly experienced Head of IB - Thailand, to lead our regional growth initiatives within the forex and/or fintech sectors. This role is responsible for driving strategic partnerships, optimizing departmental performance, and cultivating long-term relationships with partners. Main Responsibilities - Hold full ownership and accountability for IB performance and growth in Thailand, ensuring all revenue, volume, and market-expansion targets are achieved. - Drive country results by developing and executing a strategic action plan tailored to the Thai market. - Proactively identify opportunities, address challenges, and deliver measurable outcomes to ensure continuous market growth. - Lead, inspire, and coach a team of Business Development Managers to achieve their individual and team goals. - Establish clear, measurable KPIs for the department, consistently monitor performance, and take accountability for achieving results by providing guidance and corrective actions when needed. - Develop and implement strategic initiatives to acquire new partnerships while strengthening and expanding existing ones. - Collaborate closely with Customer Support, Dealing, Payments, Product, Compliance, and other teams to ensure alignment on initiatives that impact market performance. - Analyse partner performance, market data, and performance metrics to identify opportunities for growth and optimization. - Cultivate strong, long-term relationships with partners to maximize their performance and overall potential. - Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making, optimise strategies, and enhance overall departmental performance. Requirements - Degree in Business Management, Economics or any other relevant field. - 5 years of experience in Business Development and Introducing Broker (IB), within the Forex / Fintech industry, with at least 2-3 years of experience in a managerial role overseeing IB and Business Development teams. - Excellent command of both Thai and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in strategic and commercial contexts. - Proven leadership and people-management skills, with experience guiding, coaching, and developing Business Development teams to achieve measurable results. - Strong relationship-management and communication abilities, confident in conducting high-level strategic discussions with partners, stakeholders, and key market players. - Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel (pivot tables, analysis, reporting). - Deep understanding of financial markets, with solid expertise in forex, crypto, or related trading sectors. - Exceptional negotiation, pitching, and active-listening skills, with a proven track record of closing partnerships and optimising partner performance. Benefits - 10 working days of annual leave - Work remotely whilst being part of a global team - Udemy Business unlimited membership - Professional and personal development opportunities in a fast-growing environment LBX is an equal opportunity employer, fostering an inclusive and diverse environment. We do not discriminate based on any characteristic protected by the law. Candidate privacy is respected, and all data is securely stored and used solely for recruitment purposes, in line with GDPR and our internal policies. Unsuccessful applicants may have their data retained for future opportunities unless deletion is requested.
